reason: Directly studies tetrachromacy in female carriers of anomalous trichromacy. OPN1LW (red cone opsin / RCP) underlies the fourth cone class in these carriers. The paper explicitly examines the spectral dimensions of the OPN1LW/OPN1MW gene products and their psychophysical consequences. Core OPN1LW literature.

Foundational Science paper on the numbers and ratios of visual pigment genes in the X-linked OPN1LW/OPN1MW array. Directly examines OPN1LW gene copy number and its implications for normal and anomalous color vision. Central to OPN1LW genomics.

Title explicitly covers signatures of selection and gene conversion in human color vision variation. Gene conversion between OPN1LW and OPN1MW is the primary molecular mechanism driving variation and disease in these genes. Directly relevant to OPN1LW molecular evolution.

195-kb cosmid walk encompassing the Xq28 color vision pigment genes - this is the OPN1LW/OPN1MW locus. A foundational genomic mapping paper for the OPN1LW gene region. Directly relevant to OPN1LW locus structure.

Studies differential regulation of tandemly-duplicated LWS cone opsin genes (zebrafish homologs of OPN1LW) by retinoic acid signaling. Provides mechanistic insight into how the OPN1LW/OPN1MW tandem array is differentially regulated, directly relevant to understanding OPN1LW expression control.

Population genetics of X-linked OPN1LW (red pigment gene) and OPN1MW (green pigment gene) across African, Japanese, and Caucasian populations. Directly studies OPN1LW gene structure including a shortened red pigment gene variant and gene conversion. Core OPN1LW molecular genetics literature.

Classic early report of isolated foveal hypoplasia with congenital nystagmus and poor visual acuity, without albinism or aniridia. SLC38A8 loss-of-function causes isolated foveal hypoplasia (FHONDA syndrome). This paper describes the identical clinical presentation and is foundational for understanding the SLC38A8 phenotype.

Review of the Elongator complex, of which ELP4 is a core subunit. ELP4 is in the ophthalmogenetics library because 11p13 deletions encompassing ELP4 are associated with aniridia and anterior segment dysgenesis. Understanding ELP4's molecular role in tRNA modification provides essential functional context for interpreting ELP4's contribution to ophthalmic phenotypes.

Directly studies ELP4 (Elp4p/Tot7p) subunit function and its role in maintaining the structural integrity of the Elongator HAP subcomplex in yeast. ELP4 is an ophthalmogenetics gene (11p13 locus; aniridia); this foundational characterization of ELP4 protein function is relevant for interpreting its role in ophthalmic conditions.

Creates knock-in mouse model with human L-opsin (OPN1LW) variant replacing mouse M-opsin, specifically to study disease-causing OPN1LW/OPN1MW variant combinations (blue cone monochromacy, cone dystrophy). Directly relevant to OPN1LW structure-function and disease modeling.

Maps topographical distribution of L-cone (OPN1LW) versus M-cone opsin mRNA ratios across human and baboon retina using real-time PCR. Directly quantifies OPN1LW expression patterns in the retina, relevant to understanding cone subtype distribution and OPN1LW biology.

Characterizes molecular patterns and sequence polymorphisms in the red (OPN1LW) and green (OPN1MW) visual pigment genes in Japanese men. Directly studies OPN1LW gene polymorphisms relevant to color vision variation and disease risk.

Establishes quantitative foveal structural metrics (IRL ratio, OS ratio, ONL ratio) as predictors of visual acuity in foveal hypoplasia using SD-OCT in albinism. SLC38A8 mutations cause isolated foveal hypoplasia (FHONDA); the quantitative grading framework and OCT metrics validated here are directly applicable to assessing and monitoring SLC38A8 patients.

Directly genotypes OPN1LW and OPN1MW using MassArray in 454 participants and compares with pseudoisochromatic plate testing. The abstract explicitly names OPN1LW genotype analysis. Core diagnostic/epidemiologic paper for OPN1LW.

Characterizes a novel X-linked visual pigment gene with a unique exon 5 arrangement arising from intragenic unequal crossing-over between OPN1LW and OPN1MW. This is a direct study of OPN1LW/OPN1MW gene structure and its role in producing a unique dichromatic color vision defect.

Case report of surgical repair of myopic macular hole-related retinal detachment in a child with Knobloch syndrome. Knobloch syndrome is caused by COL18A1 mutations. This paper directly describes the ophthalmic management of a COL18A1-related condition and is directly relevant to COL18A1 clinical care.

Studies how TRbeta2 overexpression and thyroid hormone (TH) availability regulate differential expression of LWS cone opsin genes (zebrafish OPN1LW homologs lws1/lws2). TRbeta2 is a known regulator of human OPN1LW expression. Provides mechanistic insight into OPN1LW transcriptional regulation directly relevant to cone photoreceptor biology.

Annual Review covering the retinoid cycle in mammalian retina with direct relevance to ABCA4, LRAT, RDH11, RLBP1, RPE65, and STRA6 (all key retinoid cycle genes) as well as RHO and PDE6H. All listed gene_or_topic entries are directly covered in this review of retinoid-cycle biochemistry and therapeutic interventions.

Gene map review of inherited eye disorders covering retina, choroid, and vitreous diseases. COL2A1 (Stickler syndrome/vitreoretinopathy), OAT (gyrate atrophy of choroid/retina), and RP2 (X-linked retinitis pigmentosa) are all directly covered. Foundational mapping reference for these three ophthalmogenetics genes.

Reviews mechanism and evidence for nonsense suppression therapy in genetic eye disorders. CHM (choroideremia) and RP2 (X-linked RP) are both X-linked retinal dystrophies with nonsense mutations; this therapeutic review is directly relevant to both genes. Clearly within scope for a gene-centric ophthalmogenetics library.
